name: awesome-machine-learning-in-compilers
desc: Must read research papers and links to tools and datasets that are related to using machine learning for compilers and systems optimisation

resources.name: PROM
resources.desc: A Python Toolkit to help identify ML model misprediction after deployment (paper).

resources.name: ML-Compiler-Bridge
resources.desc: Library to interface Compilers and ML models for ML-Enabled Compiler Optimizations (paper).

resources.name: Supersonic
resources.desc: Automate reinforcement learning architecture design (paper).

resources.name: CompilerGym
resources.desc: Reinforcement learning environments for compiler optimizations (paper).

resources.name: CodeBert
resources.desc: pre-trained DNN models for programming languages (paper).

resources.name: IR2Vec
resources.desc: LLVM IR based program embeddings for machine learning (paper).

resources.name: programl
resources.desc: LLVM and XLA IR program representation for machine learning (paper).

resources.name: NeuroVectorizer
resources.desc: Using deep reinforcement learning (RL) to predict optimal vectorization compiler pragmas (paper).

resources.name: TVM
resources.desc: Open Deep Learning Compiler Stack for CPU, GPU and specialized accelerators (paper; slides).

resources.name: MLC-LLM
resources.desc: A machine learning compiler and high-performance deployment engine for large language models (Reference techniques: paper, paper and TVM).

resources.name: clgen
resources.desc: Benchmark generator using LSTMs (paper; slides).

resources.name: COBAYN
resources.desc: Compiler Autotuning using BNs (paper).

resources.name: OpenTuner
resources.desc: Framework for building domain-specific multi-objective program autotuners (paper; slides)

resources.name: ONNX-MLIR
resources.desc: Representation and Reference Lowering of ONNX Models in MLIR Compiler Infrastructure (paper).

resources.name: IREE
resources.desc: A retargetable MLIR-based machine learning compiler and runtime toolkit.

resources.name: NEURAX
resources.desc: Analytical compiler for neural network architectures. Predicts training cost, memory, and performance before training (<50ms, zero GPU). MLIR/LLVM 18 backend.

resources.name: TenSet: A Large-scale Program Performance Dataset for Learned Tensor Compilers
resources.desc: A dataset of tensor program performance records for six commonly used hardware platforms (paper).

resources.name: The Alberta Workloads for the SPEC CPU® 2017 Benchmark Suite
resources.desc: Additional workloads for the SPEC CPU2017 Benchmark Suite.

resources.name: Project CodeNet
resources.desc: Code samples written in 50+ programming languages, annotated with info, such as code size, memory footprint, CPU run time, and status (acceptance/error types)

resources.name: CodeXGLUE
resources.desc: A Machine Learning Benchmark Dataset for Code

resources.name: ANGHABENCH
resources.desc: A suite with One Million Compilable C Benchmarks (paper)

resources.name: BHive
resources.desc: A Benchmark Suite and Measurement Framework for Validating x86-64 Basic Block Performance Models (paper).

resources.name: cBench
resources.desc: 32 C benchmarks with datasets and driver scripts.

resources.name: PolyBench
resources.desc: 30 Stencil and Linear-algebra benchmarks with datasets and driver scripts. See also: GPU version, pre-computed datasets (paper).

resources.name: DeepDataFlow
resources.desc: 469k LLVM-IR files and 8.6B data-flow analysis labels for classification (paper).

resources.name: devmap
resources.desc: 650 OpenCL benchmark features and CPU/GPU classification labels (paper; slides).
